module "Pr_Layer.dss"

product 0 MaterialLayer "L_Tint" backend=Graph
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="m", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : material @L3:C1 "m"
  %1 = Constant(Value=(1, 0.5, 0.25)) : float3 @L5:C19 "BaseColor"
  %2 = SetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%0, BaseColor=%1, AttributeSetTypes="[BaseColor]") : material @L3:C1
  %3 = FunctionOutput(%2, OutputName="m", SortPriority=0) @L3:C1 "m"
  inputs %0
  outputs %3
